{{Quote|Don't tell me you're afraid to stop them? We'll hold them off at the pass!|Master Kaedan to Jedi [[Bela Kiwiiks]]|<ref name="Lost Suns 1" />}}
'''Jaric Kaedan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Also known as '''the Order's Watchman''', Kaedan was born in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the decades before the war and taken in for training by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the age of twelve, becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] under the tutelage of [[Ngani Zho]]. Serving valiantly on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the war, Kaedan was instrumental in the [[Capture of the Dread Masters|capture]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]] in [[3668 BBY]], and as a Jedi Master he fought in the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] in the last months of the war. When the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] brought the war to a close in [[3653 BBY]], Kaedan was appointed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and accompanied the rest of Order to their recently rediscovered homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Training a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the name of [[Nae Nuuv]] to Knighthood, Kaedan remained ever-vigilant against the threat of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and he joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in combating the Empire on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] after the [[Galactic War]] began. Leading a contingent to reclaim the Jedi's [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Ilum Temple]] on the Order's sacred world, Kaedan was killed by a Sith strike team during the [[Battle of Ilum]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Jaric Kaedan born in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3691 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost" /> He was discovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at the age of twelve<ref name="Codex" /> and underwent [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]],<ref name="Lost Suns 1" /> attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3668 BBY]], Kaedan led a team of troopers from the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] on a mission to [[Capture of the Dread Masters|capture]] the six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]]. Kaedan and the Special Forces team infiltrated the [[Dread Masters' dreadnaught|dreadnought]] and successfully defeated them in combat, withstanding the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] ability to influence their opponents' fear through [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. Kaedan also downloaded the dreadnought's entire Imperial database before scuttling the vessel, gaining a valuable source of intelligence for the Republic and convincing the Empire that the Dread Masters had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the assault.<ref name="Gnost" /> Sometime after becoming a Knight, Kaedan had a hostile encounter with the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]],<ref name="Lost Suns 1" /> a brutal religious sect of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Galaxy">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> and Kaedan was rescued from the situation by Master Zho. However, Kaedan became angry with Zho as a result of the encounter, and he still had not spoken with his former Master<ref name="Lost Suns 1" /> by the time of Zho's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Lost Suns 5">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 5]]</ref>

[[File:Jaric_Kaedan.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jaric during the Great Galactic War]]
As the war neared the end of its third decade, Kaedan was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] alongside [[Satele Shan]], [[Syo Bakarn]], and [[Bela Kiwiiks]], all of whom were former students of Master Zho. By that time, Kaedan had become a master of a variation of the [[Form VII/Legends|seventh form]] of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] known as "Juyo-Kos," and he was considered to be living weapon who was guided by the Force itself. The four [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] found the Republic Military's [[Forty-fifth Battalion]] in disarray after a brutal Imperial invasion, and Kaedan discussed their plans with Kiwiiks and Shan while Bakarn [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. He scoffed at what he saw as fear on the behalf of Kiwiiks, claiming that the Jedi would easily hold off the enemy at the pass, but he was contradicted by Shan. Under the leadership of Shan, the Jedi and the remaining [[Republic trooper]]s launched a furious assault on the Imperial forces, and Kaedan cut down many enemy soldiers and Sith with his twin green-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. During the battle, Kaedan rescued Bakarn from an attacking Sith by shoving his fellow Jedi out of the way and blocking the enemy's blade with his own weapons. The battle ended when Shan defeated [[Darth Mekhis]], the Sith commander on Rhen Var and a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], in a duel within [[Darth Mekhis' fortress|the Sith's fortress]].<ref name="Lost Suns 1" /> The war ended not long afterwards with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]], which forced the Republic to withdraw all of their forces and submit to the Empire's terms on account of the Imperial [[Sacking of Coruscant|invasion]] of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref>

During the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Kaedan was made a Jedi Master and later appointed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] alongside Bakarn,<ref name="The Path of a Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Path of a Jedi|Tython}}</ref> Shan, Kiwiiks, [[Orgus Din]],<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> and another Jedi, as six of the Council members had been killed during the Sacking of Coruscant.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

Some time later, as [[Tol Braga]]'s strike team, which included himself, [[Leeha Narezz]], [[Warren Sedoru]] and the [[Hero of Tython]], was preparing to depart for the Emperor's cloaked space station in hopes of capturing him so he could be redeemed, the Jedi Council and Jedi Knight [[Jomar Chul]] chose to intervene. Kaedan expressed uncertainty that Braga's plan would succeed, but Chul had a more disturbing revelation. Chul explained that he had a vision of the Hero falling to the dark side and becoming Sith and insisted he take the Hero's place on the mission. However, Satele and Kiwiiks expressed confidence in the Hero's loyalty and sanctioned the mission, to Chul's frustration as he stormed out of the Council chamber. Kaedan pleaded one last time with Braga to abandon his plan, but the latter insisted it would work.

Soon, the Council heard nothing from Braga's strike team until the Hero returned some time later, revealing that the mission had failed. As the Hero explained, the Emperor overpowered the strike team and had them under thrall. However, Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]], the [[Emperor's Wrath]], helped the Hero and company escape. Kaedan didn't trust him, stating that Sith were selfish by nature. Scourge explained that his change of allegiance was to stop the Emperor from destroying the galaxy. Three centuries ago, he had a vision of the Emperor performing a dark side ritual that would consume all life in the galaxy, but the Hero would be the one to stop him. But the ritual required a sacrifice of billions of simultaneous deaths, which would occur on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and urged haste in saving the planet. Kaedan remained suspicious of the Sith's intentions, even putting a lightsaber to Scourge's throat. Scourge insisted that he was the foremost expert on the Emperor and he was more use to them free with the Jedi; he believed could defeat the Emperor. Satele Shan sensed the truth in his words and consented to an alliance.

[[File:JaricKaedan.png|thumb|right|Kaedan on Ilum, meditating shortly before his death]]
During the Battle for [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Jaric Kaedan was placed in command of a Republic ground assault team, whose goal was to halt the Empire's [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] mining operation. Sith forces on the planet were tasked, by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]], with dispatching Jaric Kaedan (operation "First Strike"). The mission was ultimately a success, leading to the death of the famed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="First Strike" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'll show the Empire what it can do with it's demands.|Master Kaedan to the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]]|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
To his students, [[Master]] Jaric Kaedan was a harsh taskmaster, driven by the knowledge that his lessons may one day save their lives. He believed that the greatest threats to a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] came from within, and encouraged his students to master themselves before seeking mastery over a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. To the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], he was known for being a formidable enemy. He was firm in his convictions that peace in the galaxy could not be achieved whilst the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] existed. However, he showed paranoia and fear as well. When the Barsen'thor was recruiting an army on Voss, he tried to stop the Barsen'thor with fearful talk about their Force use and tried to reject a proposal by a Mystic to have more Jedi learn on Voss. He also would criticize and hastily judge others, including fellow council members; those he was to judge included Yuon Par and Kira Carsen. However, he was able to gracefully admit when he was wrong, as seen by the fact that he accepted Carsen after she overcame the Emperor's will in the heat of battle. However, he also viewed Lord Scourge with intense distaste, even threatening him with a lightsaber.

==Powers and abilities==
Powerful in both the use of the Force and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], Kaedan was considered to be a master of [[Form VII/Legends|Juyo-Kos]], the seventh combat form. In battle, Kaedan became a living weapon of the Force, and even as a Jedi Knight he was able to withstand the powerful influence of the fear-wielding Dread Masters in order to capture the six Sith Lords.<ref name="Gnost" />
